Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162) in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL ID CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
